sourceAnchors.visualArbitrationNote: Printed page 474 opens the compact syndrome summary with the statement that no or almost no reactions with `Triebüberdruck` occur in the source-defined Zwangsneurose pattern. The OCR derivative badly damages `Triebüberdruck`, so the admitted PDF governs the term.

Within Fall 40, Szondi states that total absence of Quantumspannungsreaktionen is conditioned by increased ambivalence reactions and is also a `Kennzeichen der Zwangsvorgänge`. The case illustrates the more general page-474 absence/near-absence of Triebüberdruck.

sourceExcerpt: Das totale Fehlen -von Quantumspannungsreaktionen wird durch die Erhöhung der Ambivalenzreaktionen bedingt
romanianRendering: Szondi leagă absența totală a Quantumspannungsreaktionen, în exemplul Fall 40, de creșterea reacțiilor ambivalente; rezumatul general de la p. 474 spune că în configurația Zwangsneurose apar deloc sau aproape deloc reacții cu Triebüberdruck.
doctrinalStatement: În syndromatica source-defined a Zwangsneurose, `keine oder fast keine Reaktionen mit Triebüberdruck` constituie un marker general al seriei; în Fall 40, absența totală a `Quantumspannungsreaktionen` este legată explicit de creșterea Ambivalenzreaktionen. Relația trebuie păstrată ca afirmație internă a modelului Szondi despre tensiune și ambivalență, nu ca diagnostic autonom și nu ca lege cauzală modernă.
conditions: Requires series-level inspection of Quantumspannungsreaktionen/Triebüberdruck rather than a single isolated reaction.
Read together with the source's ambivalence structure and other syndrome components.
exceptions: Do not infer Zwangsneurose solely from absent or sparse Quantumspannungsreaktionen.
Do not treat the source's statement that ambivalence conditions the absence of Quantumspannung as a contemporary causal mechanism.
Do not equate all low-quantum series with the historical Zwangsneurose pattern.
scopeNotes: Fall 40 is retained as a worked confirmation of the generic p. 474 statement, not serialized into a patient-specific doctrine.
This record may later be reviewed against existing P1 quantum-tension calculations, but remains non-executable.
